title.narrative: Restoring the natural and economic value of Virunga National Park

description.narrative: The Action will aim at preserving the rich biodiversity of the park that plays a significant role in supporting Eco-tourism and hence providing thousands of jobs all over the park. Such a protection is indispensable to ensure that populations affected by the outbreak of the Covid crisis will be able to recover from the pandemic in a sustainable way. It will also help contain the spread of Covid-19 through points of control .
